bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; requiring commemoration of the first Italian immigrant to Minnesota on the Capitol complex; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. PURPOSE.

The purpose of this act is to recognize the contributions of Italian immigrants by requiring a commemorative work on the State Capitol grounds honoring the first recorded Italian immigrant to Minnesota.

Sec. 2. COMMISSIONING AND INSTALLATION.

The Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board must conduct the commemorative works process pursuant to Minnesota Rules, part 2400.2703, and the commissioner of administration must install a commemorative work honoring the first recorded Italian immigrant to Minnesota. The Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board must issue a public call for artists and solicit input from historians and Italian-American cultural organizations to guide the design process.

Sec. 3. COMPLETION AND DEDICATION.

The Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board must complete the design and site selection phases by December 31, 2026, and the commissioner of administration must complete the installation phase by December 31, 2027. Upon completion, the Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board must host an official dedication ceremony honoring Italian American contributions to Minnesota.

Sec. 4. APPROPRIATION.

Subdivision 1.

Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board for purposes of this act. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2028.

Subd. 2.

Department of Administration.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of administration for purposes of this act. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2028.

Sec. 5. EFFECTIVE DATE.

This act is effective the day following final enactment.

The Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board must conduct the commemorative works process pursuant to Minnesota Rules, part 2400.2703, and the commissioner of administration must install a commemorative work honoring the first recorded Italian immigrant to Minnesota. The Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board must issue a public call for artists and solicit input from historians and Italian-American cultural organizations to guide the design process.

The Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board must complete the design and site selection phases by December 31, 2026, and the commissioner of administration must complete the installation phase by December 31, 2027. Upon completion, the Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board must host an official dedication ceremony honoring Italian American contributions to Minnesota.
Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board.

This act is effective the day following final enactment.
